camel_example: aliyun alikafkakopilot KopilotListConversations --region cn-hangzhou --Size 10 --IncludeAutomationOverview true --DestinationPageSize 20 --Page 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --TaskPageSize 20 --DestinationCursor 123 --TaskCursor 123 --version 2026-04-14 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the session IDs of the current user in the Console channel, sorted by creation time in descending order. Pagination is supported
description_zh: 查询当前用户在 Console 渠道下的会话 ID（按创建时间倒序），支持分页
name: KopilotListConversations

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the overview of scheduled tasks and notification channels for the account. A value of true indicates that the overview is returned. If this parameter is not specified, the overview is not returned
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回账号的定时任务与通知渠道概览。true 表示返回；未指定时不返回该概览
parameters.name: include_automation_overview

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for the scheduled task list. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 定时任务列表每页条数，默认 20，范围 1–100
parameters.name: task_page_size

parameters.help_en: The pagination cursor. Do not specify this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, pass in the value of Data.AutomationOverview.Tasks.NextCursor from the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页游标。首次查询不传，后续原样传入上次响应的 Data.AutomationOverview.Tasks.NextCursor
parameters.name: task_cursor

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for the notification channel list. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 通知渠道列表每页条数，默认 20，范围 1–100
parameters.name: destination_page_size

parameters.help_en: The pagination cursor for notification channels. Do not specify this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, pass in the value of Data.AutomationOverview.Destinations.NextCursor from the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 通知渠道分页游标。首次查询不传，后续原样传入上次响应 Data.AutomationOverview.Destinations.NextCursor
parameters.name: destination_cursor

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates success

Data.description_en: The data returned when the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据

AutomationOverview.description_en: The overview of tasks, notification channels, and quotas for the current account. Returned only when the request includes the overview and the feature is available
AutomationOverview.description_zh: 当前账号的任务、通知渠道与配额概览。仅请求包含概览且功能可用时返回

AsOf.description_en: The time when the overview was generated, in UTC ISO 8601 format
AsOf.description_zh: 概览生成时间，UTC ISO 8601 格式

DestinationQuota.description_en: The quota for the number of notification channels of the current primary account in this environment, counted across regions
DestinationQuota.description_zh: 当前主账号在本环境中的通知渠道数量配额，跨地域统计

Limit.description_en: The maximum number of tasks or channels allowed, subject to the actual configuration
Limit.description_zh: 对应任务或渠道的数量上限，以实际配置为准

Remaining.description_zh: 剩余数量，为上限减去已用数量，最小为 0

Used.description_zh: 未删除的通知渠道数量；停用渠道仍占用配额

Destinations.description_en: The paginated results of notification channels. Webhook URLs and signing keys are not returned
Destinations.description_zh: 通知渠道分页结果，不返回 Webhook 或签名密钥

LastDelivery.description_en: The most recent delivery record. This field is empty if no delivery has been made
LastDelivery.description_zh: 最近一次投递记录；尚未投递时为空

AcceptedAt.description_en: The time when the notification service accepted the delivery, in UTC ISO 8601 format. This field is empty if the delivery has not been accepted
AcceptedAt.description_zh: 通知服务接收时间，UTC ISO 8601 格式；尚未接收时为空

CreatedAt.description_en: The time when the record was created, in UTC ISO 8601 format
CreatedAt.description_zh: 当前记录创建时间，UTC ISO 8601 格式

DeliveryId.description_en: The unique identifier of the delivery record

LastAttemptAt.description_en: The time of the most recent delivery attempt, in UTC ISO 8601 format
LastAttemptAt.description_zh: 最近一次尝试发送的时间，UTC ISO 8601 格式

SendKind.description_en:
The delivery type. Valid values:
AUTO: automatic delivery.
MANUAL: manual delivery.
TEST: connectivity test
SendKind.description_zh: 发送类型：AUTO 自动、MANUAL 手动、TEST 连通性测试

Status.description_en: The most recent delivery status. ACCEPTED indicates that the notification service has accepted the delivery, but does not mean the recipient has read it
Status.description_zh: 最近投递状态。ACCEPTED 表示通知服务已接收，不代表收件人已阅读

Name.description_en: The name of the notification channel

Status.description_en:
The configuration status of the channel. Valid values:
ACTIVE: enabled.
DISABLED: disabled.
Being enabled does not indicate that a delivery has been successfully sent
Status.description_zh: 渠道配置状态：ACTIVE 为启用，DISABLED 为停用；启用不表示已经发送成功

Type.description_en: The type of the notification channel. DINGTALK_WEBHOOK indicates a DingTalk custom chatbot
Type.description_zh: 通知渠道类型。DINGTALK_WEBHOOK 表示钉钉自定义机器人

UpdatedAt.description_en: The time when the record was last updated, in UTC ISO 8601 format
UpdatedAt.description_zh: 当前记录最近更新时间，UTC ISO 8601 格式

Version.description_zh: 用于当前记录并发更新校验的版本号

NextCursor.description_en: The cursor for the next page. This field is empty if no more pages are available
NextCursor.description_zh: 下一页游标，没有下一页时为空

Total.description_en: The total number of non-deleted records in the list
Total.description_zh: 对应列表未删除记录的总数

Limit.description_zh: 对应任务或渠道的数量上限，以实际配置为准

Remaining.description_en: The remaining quota, calculated as the limit minus the used quantity. The minimum value is 0
Remaining.description_zh: 剩余数量，为上限减去已用数量，最小为 0

Used.description_zh: 已占用任务配额，统计 DRAFT、ENABLED、PAUSED、NEEDS_AUTH；已完成及已删除任务不占用

Tasks.description_en: The paginated results of scheduled tasks for the account
Tasks.description_zh: 账号定时任务分页结果

Items.description_zh: 当前页任务或通知渠道列表

ActiveRun.description_en: The currently queued or running execution record. This field is empty if no active run exists
ActiveRun.description_zh: 当前排队中或执行中的运行记录，无活动运行时为空

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code of a failed run. This field is empty if no error occurred
ErrorCode.description_zh: 运行失败的错误码；无错误时为空

ErrorMessage.description_en: The user-facing failure reason. This field is empty if no error occurred
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 可展示给用户的失败原因；无错误时为空

FinishedAt.description_en: The time when the run finished, in UTC ISO 8601 format. This field is typically empty for queued or running executions
FinishedAt.description_zh: 运行结束时间，UTC ISO 8601 格式；排队中和执行中通常为空

RunId.description_en: The unique identifier of a single run

Status.description_en:
The status of a single run. Valid values:
QUEUED: queued.
RUNNING: running
Status.description_zh: 单次运行状态：QUEUED 为排队中，RUNNING 为执行中

CronExpression.description_en: The six-field cron expression with the seconds field fixed to 0. This field is used only for the CRON schedule type
CronExpression.description_zh: 六字段 Cron 表达式，秒固定为 0，仅 CRON 类型使用

DestinationIds.description_en: The list of notification channel IDs that receive task results. A maximum of 3 IDs are supported
DestinationIds.description_zh: 接收任务结果的通知渠道 ID 列表，最多 3 个

items.description_en: The unique identifier of the notification channel

InstanceIds.description_en: The list of instance IDs within the query scope
InstanceIds.description_zh: 查询范围内的实例 ID 列表

items.description_en: The Kafka instance ID. The example is provided only to illustrate the format
items.description_zh: Kafka 实例 ID。示例仅用于说明格式

Instruction.description_en: The instruction for the scheduled task execution
Instruction.example: 查询指定实例的当前风险并汇总结果

IntervalSeconds.description_en: The fixed interval in seconds. Valid values: 900 to 31536000. This field is used only for the FIXED_INTERVAL schedule type
IntervalSeconds.description_zh: 固定间隔秒数，范围 900–31536000，仅 FIXED_INTERVAL 使用

MaxRunSeconds.description_en: The time budget for a single task run, in seconds. Default value: 600. Valid values: 30 to 1800
MaxRunSeconds.description_zh: 单次任务运行时长预算，单位秒；默认 600，范围 30–1800

MaxTokens.description_en: The token budget for a single task run. Default value: 3000000. Valid values: 1000 to 10000000
MaxTokens.description_zh: 单次任务 Token 预算；默认 3000000，范围 1000–10000000

Name.description_en: The name of the scheduled task

RegionId.description_en: The region where the queried resources reside

ResourceMode.description_en:
The resource scope mode. Valid values:
ACCOUNT: account-level query.
NONE: no resource task.
EXPLICIT: specified instances
ResourceMode.description_zh: 资源范围模式：ACCOUNT 账号查询、NONE 无资源任务、EXPLICIT 指定实例

RunAt.description_en: The one-time execution time in ISO 8601 format with time zone. This field is used only for the ONCE schedule type
RunAt.description_zh: 一次性执行时间，带时区的 ISO 8601 格式，仅 ONCE 使用

ScheduleType.description_en:
The schedule type. Valid values:
ONCE: one-time execution.
CRON: cron expression.
FIXED_INTERVAL: fixed interval
ScheduleType.description_zh: 调度类型：ONCE 一次性、CRON 表达式、FIXED_INTERVAL 固定间隔

SessionMode.description_en:
The session mode for displaying results. Valid values:
SHARED: shared session.
PER_RUN: independent session for each run
SessionMode.description_zh: 结果展示会话模式：SHARED 为共享会话，PER_RUN 为每次运行独立会话

TargetSessionId.description_en: The ID of the target session that stores run results in shared mode
TargetSessionId.description_zh: 共享模式下承载运行结果的目标会话 ID

Timezone.description_en: The scheduling time zone. Default value: Asia/Shanghai

CreatedAt.description_en: The time when the record was created, in UTC ISO 8601 format
CreatedAt.description_zh: 当前记录创建时间，UTC ISO 8601 格式

LastCompletedRun.description_en: The most recent completed run record, including failed runs. This field is empty if no record exists
LastCompletedRun.description_zh: 最近一次已结束的运行记录，包括失败的运行；没有记录时为空

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code of a failed run. This field is empty if no error occurred
ErrorCode.description_zh: 运行失败的错误码；无错误时为空

ErrorMessage.description_en: The user-facing failure reason. This field is empty if no error occurred
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 可展示给用户的失败原因；无错误时为空

FinishedAt.description_en: The time when the run finished, in UTC ISO 8601 format. This field is empty if the run has not finished
FinishedAt.description_zh: 运行结束时间，UTC ISO 8601 格式；尚未结束时为空

RunId.description_en: The unique identifier of a single run

Status.description_en: The status of the most recent completed run. For example, SUCCEEDED indicates success and FAILED indicates failure
Status.description_zh: 最近已结束运行的状态，例如 SUCCEEDED 表示成功，FAILED 表示失败

Name.description_en: The name of the scheduled task

NextRunAt.description_en: The next scheduled execution time, in UTC ISO 8601 format. This field is empty if no next run is scheduled
NextRunAt.description_zh: 下次计划执行时间，UTC ISO 8601 格式；无下次计划时为空

ScheduleDescription.description_en: The human-readable description of the execution schedule

SessionMode.description_en:
The session mode for displaying results. Valid values:
SHARED: shared session.
PER_RUN: independent session for each run
SessionMode.description_zh: 结果展示会话模式：SHARED 为共享会话，PER_RUN 为每次运行独立会话

SourceSessionId.description_en: The ID of the source session from which the task was created
SourceSessionId.description_zh: 创建任务的来源会话 ID

Status.description_en:
The status of the scheduled task. Valid values:
DRAFT: Draft.
ENABLED: Enabled.
PAUSED: Paused.
NEEDS_AUTH: Pending authorization.
COMPLETED: Completed.

This status is independent of the running status
Status.description_zh: 定时任务状态。DRAFT 为草稿，ENABLED 为已启用，PAUSED 为已暂停，NEEDS_AUTH 为待授权，COMPLETED 为已完成。与运行状态独立

TargetSessionId.description_en: The ID of the target session that stores run results in shared mode
TargetSessionId.description_zh: 共享模式下承载运行结果的目标会话 ID

Version.description_zh: 用于当前记录并发更新校验的版本号

Total.description_en: The total number of non-deleted records in the list
Total.description_zh: 对应列表未删除记录的总数

AsOf.description_zh: 概览生成时间，UTC ISO 8601 格式

EnabledCount.description_en: The number of associated tasks in the ENABLED status
EnabledCount.description_zh: 关联任务中处于 ENABLED 状态的数量

HasScheduledTask.description_en: Indicates whether the current session has associated scheduled tasks that are in the ENABLED, PAUSED, or NEEDS_AUTH status
HasScheduledTask.description_zh: 当前会话是否关联已启用、已暂停或待授权的定时任务

TaskCount.description_en: The total number of associated tasks. Only tasks in the ENABLED, PAUSED, or NEEDS_AUTH status are counted
TaskCount.description_zh: 关联任务总数，仅统计 ENABLED、PAUSED、NEEDS_AUTH 状态

ScheduledTaskInfoBySessionId.description_en: A mapping that uses session IDs as keys and associated task summaries as values
ScheduledTaskInfoBySessionId.description_zh: 以会话 ID 为键、关联任务摘要为值的映射

Used.description_zh: 已占用任务配额，统计 DRAFT、ENABLED、PAUSED、NEEDS_AUTH；已完成及已删除任务不占用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
